The image has white text overlaid: 'during a speed chase' at the top and 'which song are you blasting in your car?' at the bottom.
meme_captions: The meme humorously juxtaposes the high-stakes, dangerous situation of a police chase with the mundane, personal act of choosing music to listen to while driving, implying that even in extreme circumstances, people might still be focused on their playlist.
title: Speed Chase Playlist

img_captions: A large group of men are kneeling or sitting on a cobblestone street in front of a large stone building, many with their heads bowed.
The men are dressed in dark clothing, and some are wearing hoodies or caps.
Several prayer mats are laid out on the ground in front of them.
The setting appears to be an outdoor public square or plaza.
meme_captions: The meme uses the image of men in prayer to make a hateful and false claim that they are 'demonic entities' and 'under the spell of evil,' suggesting they are incapable of empathy or moral restraint.
title: Hateful Misrepresentation of Prayer
